{{about|webcomics of the American TV series ''Heroes''|other uses of "Heroes"|Heroes (disambiguation)}}
{{DISPLAYTITLE:List of ''Heroes'' graphic novels}}
This is a list of issues of [[NBC]]'s ''[[Heroes (American TV series)|Heroes]]'' [[webcomic]], which supplements the [[psychological thriller]] [[Superhero fiction|superhero]] television series of the same name. The comics, which NBC refers to as [[graphic novel]]s, were made available on their official website each Tuesday<ref name="NBC Heroes Comics">{{cite web|work=NBC.com |title=Heroes Comics |url=http://www.nbc.com/Heroes/novels/ |access-date=2007-10-27 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071128022233/http://www.nbc.com/Heroes/novels/ |archive-date=2007-11-28 }}</ref> as part of the [[Heroes Evolutions]] experience, starting with ''Monsters'' whose release coincided with the first episode of the show.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nbc.com/Heroes/evolutions/ |title=Heroes Evolutions |access-date=2009-02-15 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090216113944/http://www.nbc.com/Heroes/evolutions/ |archive-date=2009-02-16 }}</ref> They ceased publication on June 9, 2010 with the release of ''From the Files of Primatech, Part 8''.  Written by the show's writers and drawn by [[Aspen Comics]],<ref>Is 'Heroes' Headed To Print?, by Deahl, Rachel, Publishers Weekly, 12/4/2006, Vol. 253, Issue 48</ref> they were generally 7-9 pages long, the first page of which is always an advertisement for a vehicle made by [[Nissan Motors|Nissan]], one of the sponsors for the series. The comics give additional character background and plot information not shown in the television episodes.

[[WildStorm]], a subsidiary of [[DC Comics]] released the first 34 chapters in a hardcover volume on November 7, 2007 entitled "Volume One", with a softcover version released later. The collection also includes Tim Sale's artwork as seen on the show.<ref>{{cite web | title=HEROES VOL. 1 | publisher=DC Comics | url= http://www.dccomics.com/graphic-novels/heroes-vol-1}}</ref> "Volume Two" was released on November 19, 2008, and includes chapters 35-80 bound in a hardcover book.<ref>[http://www.dccomics.com/graphic-novels/heroes-vol-2 HEROES VOL. 2<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref>

The comics were available in both [[Portable Document Format|PDF]] and [[Adobe Flash|Flash]] formats; but the NBC page no longer exists. The PDF versions are linked below with archived versions made available via the [[Wayback Machine]] where possible. The Flash versions often offered a link to a "[[Easter egg (virtual)|hidden surprise]]", also listed below. A few also had an animated version.

==Season 1==
The comics listed here were published during Season One of the show, and continued through the summer preceding Season Two.<ref name="evolutions">{{cite web|work=NBC.com |title=Heroes Evolutions |url=http://www.nbc.com/Heroes/evolutions/ |access-date=2007-10-10 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071009141025/http://www.nbc.com/Heroes/evolutions/ |archive-date=2007-10-09 }}</ref>
